system.description:
Beginning at 1st level, as a Medical Ninja you gain the ability to learn jutsu with the Medical Keyword.

Jutsu you cast with the Medical Keyword may use Wisdom for their attack and damage rolls, as well as Save DC calculation.

Finally, Medicine checks you make can use Intelligence or Wisdom and you gain a rank of Mastery in the Medicine skill. You gain an additional rank in Mastery for Medicine at levels 8 and 12.
